    The centre corner of the preprojective category of a star (Lemma A.3) #

    lem:star-return-reduction. For a star rooted at its centre o, oriented away from o, let x_i be the closed path of length two along arm i. The vertices of arm i are v_0 = o, v_1, …. "For j ≥ 2, the mesh at v_{j-1} replaces the backtrack v_{j-1} v_j v_{j-1} by v_{j-1} v_{j-2} v_{j-1}. … Iteration expresses every closed path at o as a word in the x_i. The centre mesh gives ∑ x_i = 0. Moving a power down its arm gives x_i^{L_i+1} = 0."

    We prove the iteration in the following form: every path from o to v is, modulo the relations, a word in the x_i followed by the geodesic from o to v (normal_form). (In StarV L the arm i has L i + 1 vertices, so the manuscript's L_i is L i + 1.)

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
